release_notes.en-US: Improved phone and desktop layouts, adaptive accessible dialogs, compact pagination, touch-friendly video reordering, and mobile YouTube tab handling. Fixed playlist builder navigation, filtered reordering, settings refresh across tabs, Firefox OAuth redirect validation, and backup validation. Updated dependencies and release packaging. Corrected Firefox data disclosures and added separate optional consent for account features and YouTube search.

version.approval_notes: Source archive is included. Use Node.js 22 or newer: npm ci at repository root, then npm ci in apps/browser-extension/playlist-manager, then npm run build from root. Firefox output is dist/firefox. The Svelte/TypeScript source is compiled and minified with Rollup; packages/build-tools/patch-innerhtml.js runs during the build. Local playlist creation/editing/import/export and backups work without signing in. Optional YouTube API features require the user's own API credentials and Google account; they are not needed to test core local functionality. The extension has no telemetry. Tests include 120 unit tests and real desktop Chromium/Firefox route and keyboard-dialog checks; Android user-agent tests do not substitute for a physical-device test. Supersedes withdrawn candidate 1.1.0: corrected data declarations for video URLs/metadata; optional authentication/identifying/search consent is requested on feature use, with guards for persisted sessions and network requests.
